questions_and_answers.question_text: Why should you not overuse shìzhe?
Name two other ways to express "try" in Chinese.
What does zhuānyè mean in the PRC?
Write the Chinese for "Try it on."
Write the Chinese for "I've never made dumplings, but I can try."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ méi zuòguo jiǎozi, zuòzuo kàn ba.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "My major in college was political science."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ zài dàxué xuéde zhuānyè shi zhèngzhìxué.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "This article is well organized."
How is the idea of "trying" sometimes conveyed without any special word?

answers.answer_text: It is implicit in the verb itself — e.g., Wǒ gěile, tā bú yào ("I tried to give it to him, but he didn't want it").

articles.text:
10. A: Zhèige dìqūde nóngyè shēngchǎn Is there anything distinctive about the
       yǒu shénme tèdiǎn ma?         agricultural production of this region?
    B: Wǒmen shìzhe zǔzhīle jǐge    We have organized a few specialized
       zhuānyèhuàde gōngshè,         communes on a trial basis. Their
       tāmende shēngchǎn bǐjiào yǒu  production set-up is rather distinctive.
       tèdiǎn.

Notes on No. 10

yǒu shénme tèdiǎn ma?: "does...have any distinctive points?" — here translated more idiomatically as "is there anything distinctive about...?"

shìzhe zǔzhīle...: "TRYING-LY organized..." i.e., "organized ON A TRIAL BASIS."

Nǐ shìzhe nèiyang zuò xíng bu    Try doing it that way and see if it
xíng.                            works.
Zhèishuāng xié wǒ shìzhe chuān,  I tried to put these shoes on, but
chuānbushàng.                    couldn't get them on.

DO NOT OVERUSE shìzhe; there are other more common ways to express English "try." Sometimes the idea of trying is IMPLICIT IN THE VERB ITSELF:

Zhèipiān wénzhāng wǒ kànle,      I tried to read this article, but I
kànbuxiàqu.                      couldn't.
Wǒ gěile, tā bú yào.             I tried to give it to him, but he didn't
                                 want it.

Sometimes "try" can be expressed by REDUPLICATING the verb:

Nǐ chuānchuan.                   Try it on.
Wǒ kāile kāi, kāibukāi.          I tried to open it, but couldn't get it
                                 open.

— or by a reduplicated verb PLUS KÀN:

Wǒ méi zuòguo jiǎozi, zuòzuo     I've never made jiǎozi (dumplings), but
kàn ba.                          I can try.

zǔzhī: "to organize; organization"

Zhèipiān wénzhāng zǔzhīde hěn    This article is well organized.
hǎo.
Zhèige zǔzhī yǐjing yǒu wǔshiwàn This organization already has 500,000
rén le.                          people.

zhuānyè: "special line/field/discipline; specialization." This is used in the PRC for one's "MAJOR" subject in college, or for one's professional specialization.

Wǒ zài dàxué xuéde zhuānyè shi   My major in college was political
zhèngzhìxué.                     science.

zhuānyèhuà: "specialized; specialization"
